note: Expected verdicts for the shared redaction corpus. Authoritative copy is kept with the abyo PDF Editor; github.com/abyo-software/redaction-check-corpus publishes it and the browser checker mirrors it. generate.py deliberately carries no expectations. #12 must be produced with Acrobat and is pending until it arrives; #13/#13b were produced with the abyo editor's CLI; #90 is a generated stand-in used only to test for false positives. mustNotFlag lists checks that would be a false positive on that file; the suite fails if any of them is raised. acceptVerdicts appears only on codec-dependent cases (spec imageDecoding). A pending case's file is absent and harnesses skip it.
